Riven is looking deeper into the burning settlement.

She suddenly hears the same strange sound
from somewhere far ahead.

Through the smoke,
she briefly sees the mysterious dark figure
move across the road between burning buildings.

Riven immediately sprints after it.

She chases the figure deeper into the settlement,
occasionally catching brief glimpses of it
farther ahead through the smoke.

isolated area between burning buildings.

slowly appears through the smoke ahead.

the burning village road.

A faint unnatural sound
comes from deep inside the settlement.

Far ahead,

the Mysterious Dark Figure
briefly moves across an opening

as she runs at full speed
deeper into the burning settlement.

the smoke-filled village road.

Riven occasionally catches

without slowing down.

fire,

the smoke ahead slowly shifts.
